notes: All 12 views inspected. Rejected on quality, not rights. The piece is a plain square-section tapered vase with an undecorated warm off-white glaze: there is no pattern anywhere on it despite the upstream name. Geometry is clean and the interior and foot ring are correct, but silhouette and material interest both score 4 and the mean of 4.4 falls below the library's 4.6 approval threshold. The library already holds stronger ceramic vases, so this adds volume rather than value.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
